rounds.name: Kattegat Strait
rounds.fact: The Kattegat is a shallow sea area bounded by the Jutland peninsula in the west and Sweden in the east.

rounds.name: Kamchatka Peninsula
rounds.fact: The Kamchatka Peninsula lies in the Russian Far East between the Pacific Ocean and the Sea of Okhotsk.

rounds.name: Isthmus of Panama
rounds.fact: The narrow Isthmus of Panama connects North and South America and is traversed by the Panama Canal.

rounds.name: Cape York Peninsula
rounds.fact: Cape York Peninsula is a large remote peninsula located in Far North Queensland, Australia.

rounds.name: Bab-el-Mandeb
rounds.fact: The Bab-el-Mandeb strait connects the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden between Yemen and Djibouti.
